title: Charting the European LLM Benchmarking Landscape: A New Taxonomy and a Set of Best Practices

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on culturally sensitive concepts, identifying Western-centric leanings using global benchmarks (e.g., Global-MMLU), and testing models on native, culture-specific datasets (e.g., PLCC, CUS-QA) rather than machine-translated English benchmarks.

Comparing LLM performance and capabilities across different standard languages, non-standard varieties, and dialects using parallel translated datasets and dialect-specific benchmarks (e.g., DIALECTBENCH) to measure the evaluation gap between English and non-English models.

Included in the proposed benchmarking taxonomy under the 'Bias' category (Table 4), specifically referencing datasets like the Winogender Schema Diagnostics which assess gender bias via coreference resolution tasks.

Included in the taxonomy's 'Bias' category, referencing the DecodingTrust benchmark collection to systematically assess whether a model's performance on a task is unjustifiably different across various groups and attributes.
